claim.claim-text: 1. A semiconductor device comprising:

2. The semiconductor device of claim 1, further comprising: a first insulation layer (131) provided on the first surface of the first conductive semiconductor layer (124), the first surface of the second conductive semiconductor layer (127), and a side surface of the active layer (126).

3. The semiconductor device of claim 2, further comprising: a second insulation layer (132) provided on the first cover electrode (152), the second cover electrode (164), and the first insulation layer (131).
4. The semiconductor device of claim 1, wherein

the first electrode (151) includes protrusions (151b) extending from the second surface of the first electrode (151), and a groove provided on the second surface of the first electrode (151) and between the protrusions, and the first cover electrode (152) extends into the groove of the first electrode (151).
5. The semiconductor device of claim 4, wherein one of the protrusions (151b) has an upper width (d3) ranging from 1 um to 10 um.
6. The semiconductor device of claim 5, further comprising an oxide film between the protrusions of the first electrode (151) and the first cover electrode (152).
7. The semiconductor device of claim 1, wherein

a plan view of the semiconductor device includes a light emitting region that includes a surface of the second cover electrode (164) that is opposite to the first surface of the second conductive semiconductor layer (127), and a non-light emitting region that includes a surface of the first cover electrode (152) that is opposite to the first surface of the first conductive semiconductor layer (124), and an area of the non-light emitting region is smaller than an area of the light emitting region.
8. The semiconductor device of claim 7, wherein a ratio of the area of the non-light emitting region to the area of the light emitting region ranges between 1:1.1 and 1:1.15.
9. The semiconductor device of claim 7, a ratio of a perimeter of the light emitting region to the area of the light emitting region ranges between 0.02 and 0.05 (1/um).
10. The semiconductor device of claim 2, wherein

the first insulation layer (131) and the first electrode (151) are separated on the first surface of the first conductive semiconductor layer (124), and the second cover electrode (164) covers a side of the second electrode (161).
11. The semiconductor device of claim 1, wherein the first cover electrode (152) or the second cover electrode (164) has an exposed outermost layer containing Au.

12. The semiconductor device of claim 1, comprising: a stepped portion (211) extending from the first surface of the first conductive semiconductor layer (124) where the first electrode (151) is disposed to the first surface of the second conductive semiconductor layer (127) where the second electrode (161) is disposed.

13. The semiconductor device of claim 12, wherein the stepped portion (211) includes a first part (E11) where the first electrode (151) is disposed, a second part (E12) where the second electrode 161 is disposed, a third part (E13) where the first insulation layer (131) is disposed between the first part (E11) and the second part (E12), and a fourth part (E14) where the first cover electrode (152) is disposed between the first part (E11) and the third part (E13).
14. The semiconductor device of claim 13, wherein

the third part (E13) includes a first third part (E13-1) where the first cover electrode (152) overlapping with the first insulation layer (131) in a first direction perpendicular to an upper surface of the first conductive semiconductor layer (124), and the first third part (E13-1) has a width greater than 0 µm and less than 4 µm in a second direction perpendicular to the first direction.

15. The semiconductor device of claim 13, wherein the stepped portion (211) includes a fifth part (E15) where the second cover electrode (164) overlaps with the first insulation layer (131) in a first direction perpendicular to an upper surface of the first conductive semiconductor layer (124).
